function: Robust linear precoder for massive MU-MIMO downlink under imperfect CSI, maximizing ergodic weighted sum-rate, by deep unfolding of the PO-WMMSE algorithm (pp. 2-4).
system: Massive MU-MIMO downlink, TDD, BS with 64-antenna UPA, 10 users with 2 antennas each, 3.5 GHz, flat fading, imperfect CSI (aging); no RIS (pp. 2, 4).
method: Deep-unfolded PO-WMMSE Net, 5 layers with learnable Mr x Mr matrices; unsupervised layer-by-layer training on the weighted sum-rate loss with stochastic gradient descent (pp. 4-5).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa samples, scenario 3GPP_38.901_UMa_NLOS at 3.5 GHz; 200 slots, 100 for training and 100 for testing; posterior CSI from a Gauss-Markov model (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: 100 slots train, other 100 slots test, same QuaDRiGa scenario; evaluated at 30 and 120 km/h, 0 to 20 dB SNR, blocks 1 to 6 (pp. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: SWMMSE [4], non-robust WMMSE [13], and SWMMSE with 100 iterations as upper bound; no learned baseline compared (p. 4).
metrics: Sum-rate (bit/s) and percent of the estimated upper bound versus iterations or layers, block index and SNR (Fig. 3, p. 5); complexity order (Table I).
complexity: Table I: order O(L(Mt+q^3)+LK(B^2Mr^2+MtMr+q^2Mr+Mr^3)), 7e5 against 3e6 for SWMMSE; linear in Mt (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "channel samples according to the widely used QuaDRiGa model [3]"; p. 4: "3GPP_38.901_UMa_NLOS"
q2_support: p. 4: "100 slots samples are used for training, the other 100 slots are used for testing all the algorithms"; a held-out part of the same data, with no unseen scenario, antenna number or user number tested.
q3_support: p. 4: "We adopt the SWMMSE in [4] and the non-robust WMMSE (only uses the mean of posterior CSI) in [13] to evaluate the performance of PO-WMMSE Net"; both are non-learned, and no earlier learned precoder is simulated.
q4_support: p. 5: "the computational complexity of SWMMSE and PO-WMMSE Net under the typical configuration above is given in Table I"
q5_support: p. 4: "channel samples according to the widely used QuaDRiGa model [3]"; the channels come from a simulator, and the paper gives no link, DOI or release statement for code or data and uses no measured data.
notes: Included because deep unfolding with trained parameters counts as learned (p. 4); area 3 because the network designs the BS precoder. The PO-WMMSE algorithm itself is non-learned (pp. 3-4) and is not simulated alone. q3 is 0 because the numerical results compare only SWMMSE and WMMSE; learned precoders [3], [6], [10], [12] are only discussed in the introduction and in Section III-B (pp. 1, 4), never simulated. q2 is 0 because the 30 and 120 km/h cases, the six blocks and the SNR sweep change CSI accuracy or SNR, and the paper does not say the network was trained under a different condition. q5 is 0 because QuaDRiGa is a channel simulator and the generated samples and code are not released.
